name: CNR Finance
description: Finance universe for revenue, ledger, budget, receivables and payables reporting.

tables.name: DT_PERIOD_CALENDAR
tables.sql: SELECT PERIOD_ID, FISCAL_YEAR, FISCAL_YEAR*100 + PERIOD_NUMBER AS YEAR_PERIOD FROM CNR_FIN.FISCAL_PERIODS

contexts.name: REVENUE
contexts.description: Freight billing (revenue sub-ledger) with customer, commodity, lane and period.

contexts.name: RECEIVABLES
contexts.description: Accounts receivable invoices with customer and period.

contexts.name: PAYABLES
contexts.description: Accounts payable invoices with vendor, cost center, account and period.

contexts.name: LEDGER
contexts.description: General ledger journal lines with account, cost center and period.

contexts.name: BUDGET
contexts.description: Budget lines with account, cost center and period.

items.name: Fiscal Year
items.description: Fiscal year (January to December).

items.name: Fiscal Quarter
items.description: Fiscal quarter label, e.g. 2025-Q2.

items.name: Fiscal Period
items.description: Fiscal period (month) number, 1 to 12.

items.name: Period Start Date
items.description: First calendar day of the fiscal period.

items.name: Period Closed
items.description: Whether the fiscal period is closed for posting.

items.name: Customer Name
items.description: Legal name of the shipper billed for the freight.

items.name: Customer Id
items.description: Customer account number.

items.name: Industry
items.description: Customer's industry.

items.name: Key Account
items.description: Yes when the customer is managed as a key account.

items.name: Customer Country
items.description: Country of the customer's head office.

items.name: Commodity
items.description: Commodity shipped.

items.name: Commodity Group
items.description: Commodity group (business unit), e.g. Grain and Fertilizers.

items.name: Business Segment
items.description: Business segment the commodity group reports into.

items.name: Origin Region
items.description: Operating region of the origin station.

items.name: Origin Province
items.description: Province or state of the origin station.

items.name: Destination Region
items.description: Operating region of the destination station.

items.name: Haul Length Band
items.description: Short, medium or long haul.

items.name: Cost Center
items.description: Cost center name.

items.name: Department
items.description: Department that owns the cost center.

items.name: Cost Center Region
items.description: Region of the cost center.

items.name: Account Name
items.description: General ledger account name.

items.name: Account Type
items.description: Revenue, Expense, Asset, Liability or Equity.

items.name: Statement Line
items.description: Financial statement line the account rolls up to.

items.name: Vendor Name
items.description: Supplier name.

items.name: Vendor Category
items.description: Supplier category.

items.name: Aging Bucket
items.description: Days-past-due band of the open receivable.
items.select: CASE WHEN AR_INVOICES.DAYS_PAST_DUE <= 0 THEN 'Current' WHEN AR_INVOICES.DAYS_PAST_DUE <= 30 THEN '1-30' WHEN AR_INVOICES.DAYS_PAST_DUE <= 60 THEN '31-60' WHEN AR_INVOICES.DAYS_PAST_DUE <= 90 THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END

items.name: Aging Band (lookup)
items.description: Aging band from the AGING_BANDS lookup table.

items.name: Payment Status
items.description: Paid, partially paid or open.

items.name: AP Aging Bucket
items.description: Days-past-due band of the open payable.

items.name: Freight Revenue
items.description: Freight revenue: line-haul + fuel surcharge + accessorial, in C$.

items.name: Revenue
items.description: Line-haul revenue from billing.

items.name: Fuel Surcharge Revenue
items.description: Fuel surcharge billed to customers.

items.name: Carloads
items.description: Number of carloads moved.

items.name: Revenue Ton Miles
items.description: Revenue ton-miles (RTM).

items.name: Revenue per Carload
items.description: Freight revenue divided by carloads.

items.name: Active Customers
items.description: Customers with at least one billing line.

items.name: Revenue
items.description: Total revenues posted to the general ledger.

items.name: Operating Expenses
items.description: Operating expenses posted to the general ledger.

items.name: Labour Expense
items.description: Labour and fringe benefits (accounts 5000-5099).

items.name: Fuel Expense
items.description: Fuel expense (accounts 5200-5299).

items.name: Operating Ratio
items.description: Operating expenses as a share of revenues (lower is better).

items.name: Revenue Budget
items.description: Budgeted revenue.

items.name: Expense Budget
items.description: Budgeted operating expense.

items.name: AR Invoiced Amount
items.description: Amount invoiced to customers.

items.name: AR Open Amount
items.description: Open (unpaid) receivable balance at the snapshot date.

items.name: AR Overdue Amount
items.description: Open receivables past their due date.

items.name: Avg Days to Pay
items.description: Average days customers take to pay.

items.name: AP Invoiced Amount
items.description: Amount invoiced by suppliers.

items.name: AP Open Amount
items.description: Open (unpaid) payable balance.

items.name: Headcount
items.description: Full-time equivalents in the cost center.

items.name: Closed Periods
items.description: Only fiscal periods closed for posting.

items.name: Open Invoices
items.description: Only receivables with an open balance.

items.name: Key Accounts
items.description: Only key-account customers.

items.name: Fiscal Year Prompt
items.description: Prompts for one fiscal year.
